title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Beijing grid point, 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-19
claims: The archive returns a grid point at 39.89455N, 116.35983E, 47 m elevation, in timezone Asia/Shanghai.
The nine daily values cover 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-19.
Daily maximum temperatures range from 16.2C to 26.6C, with a median of 21.5C.
Daily minimum temperatures range from 6.8C to 15.9C, with a median of 12.8C.
One of the nine days has precipitation of at least 1 mm and one has at least 5 mm; the largest daily total is 52.2 mm on 2026-10-17.
On race day 2026-10-18 the daily maximum is 17.2C, the minimum is 10.5C and precipitation is 0.0 mm.
These are modelled grid values, not measurements taken on the course.
